message.content: Search this repository (/bench/repo) for the struct that implements the database driver for PostgreSQL. Look for driver implementations, likely in a database/drivers directory or similar. Report the exact struct name and the file path where it is defined. Be thorough — check for interfaces like a "Driver" or "Database" interface and which struct implements the PostgreSQL variant.

The PostgreSQL database driver is implemented by the struct named `DB`.

- Struct name: `DB` (defined in package `postgres`)
- File path: `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go` (lines 16-19)

Details:
- The interface it implements is `store.Driver` (defined in the `github.com/usememos/memos/store` package). `NewDB` returns `store.Driver` and the code explicitly assigns `var driver store.Driver = &DB{...}`.
- `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go` wires it up: `NewDBDriver` switches on `profile.Driver` and calls `postgres.NewDB(profile)` for the `"postgres"` case (alongside `sqlite.NewDB` and `mysql.NewDB`).

Note on naming: each driver package (`postgres`, `mysql`, `sqlite`) defines its own struct simply called `DB`, so the PostgreSQL variant is disambiguated by its package/path (`store/db/postgres`), not by a unique struct name. The rest of the files in `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/` (e.g. `memo.go`, `user.go`) define methods on this same `*DB` receiver to satisfy the full `store.Driver` interface.
